all_versions_authors_drafts_v3.sql:
SELECT k.chunk_id,
                   k.doc_id,
                   d.version AS doc_version,
                   d.source_system,
                   d.source_url,
                   d.title,
                   d.author_id,
                   k.content,
                   k.kind,
                   d.created_at,
                   d.updated_at,
                   d.metadata->>'origin' AS origin,
                   k.score
            FROM (
            SELECT * FROM (
                SELECT p.*,
                       CASE WHEN p.content_hit THEN 0
                            ELSE ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                                PARTITION BY p.doc_id, p.content_hit
                                ORDER BY p.score DESC, p.chunk_id
                            )
                       END AS _title_rn
                FROM (
            SELECT c.chunk_id,
                   c.doc_id,
                   c.content,
                   c.kind,
                   c.chunk_index,
                   c.first_seen_version,
                   c.last_seen_version,
                   paradedb.score(c.chunk_id) AS score,
                   (c.content_tsv @@ to_tsquery('english', $4)) AS content_hit
            FROM chunks c
            WHERE c.customer_id = current_setting('app.current_customer_id', true)
              AND c.chunk_id @@@ paradedb.boolean(must => ARRAY[
                    paradedb.match('customer_id', $1, conjunction_mode => true),
                    
                    
                    paradedb.boolean(should => ARRAY[
                      paradedb.boost(10.0, paradedb.match('title', $2)),
                      paradedb.match('content', $2)
                    ])
                  ])
              
            ORDER BY paradedb.score(c.chunk_id) DESC
            LIMIT $7
        ) p
            ) q
            WHERE q.content_hit OR q._title_rn <= $8
        ) k
            JOIN documents d
              ON k.doc_id = d.doc_id
             AND d.customer_id = $1
             AND d.version BETWEEN k.first_seen_version AND k.last_seen_version
            WHERE TRUE
              
              AND d.source_system = ANY($5::text[])
              
              
              AND d.author_id = ANY($6::text[])
              
              
        
            ORDER BY score DESC, chunk_id
            LIMIT $3

SELECT k.chunk_id,
                   k.doc_id,
                   d.version AS doc_version,
                   d.source_system,
                   d.source_url,
                   d.title,
                   d.author_id,
                   k.content,
                   k.kind,
                   d.created_at,
                   d.updated_at,
                   d.metadata->>'origin' AS origin,
                   k.score
            FROM (
            SELECT * FROM (
                SELECT p.*,
                       CASE WHEN p.content_hit THEN 0
                            ELSE ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                                PARTITION BY p.doc_id, p.content_hit
                                ORDER BY p.score DESC, p.chunk_id
                            )
                       END AS _title_rn
                FROM (
            SELECT c.chunk_id,
                   c.doc_id,
                   c.content,
                   c.kind,
                   c.chunk_index,
                   c.first_seen_version,
                   c.last_seen_version,
                   paradedb.score(c.chunk_id) AS score,
                   (c.content_tsv @@ to_tsquery('english', $4)) AS content_hit
            FROM chunks c
            WHERE c.customer_id = current_setting('app.current_customer_id', true)
              AND c.chunk_id @@@ paradedb.boolean(must => ARRAY[
                    paradedb.match('customer_id', $1, conjunction_mode => true),
                    paradedb.term('visibility', 'approved'),
                    paradedb.match('project_id', $8, conjunction_mode => true),
                    paradedb.boolean(should => ARRAY[
                      paradedb.boost(10.0, paradedb.match('title', $2)),
                      paradedb.match('content', $2)
                    ])
                  ])
              AND c.last_seen_version = 2147483647
            ORDER BY paradedb.score(c.chunk_id) DESC
            LIMIT $10
        ) p
            ) q
            WHERE q.content_hit OR q._title_rn <= $11
        ) k
            JOIN documents d
              ON k.doc_id = d.doc_id
             AND d.customer_id = $1
             AND d.version BETWEEN k.first_seen_version AND k.last_seen_version
            WHERE TRUE
              AND d.valid_to IS NULL
              AND d.source_system = ANY($5::text[])
              AND d.doc_type = ANY($6::text[])
              AND d.visibility = 'approved'
              
              AND d.metadata->>'source_key' = ANY($7::text[])
              AND d.metadata->>'project_id' = $9
        
            ORDER BY score DESC, chunk_id
            LIMIT $3

keyless_keys_per_source_recency.sql:
SELECT chunk_id, doc_id, doc_version, source_system, source_url,
                   title, author_id, content, kind, created_at, updated_at, score
            FROM (
                SELECT sub.*,
                       ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                           PARTITION BY sub.source_system ORDER BY updated_at DESC, chunk_id
                       ) AS _ps_rn
                FROM (
            SELECT k.chunk_id,
                   k.doc_id,
                   d.version AS doc_version,
                   d.source_system,
                   d.source_url,
                   d.title,
                   d.author_id,
                   k.content,
                   k.kind,
                   d.created_at,
                   d.updated_at,
                   d.metadata->>'origin' AS origin,
                   k.score
            FROM (
            SELECT * FROM (
                SELECT p.*,
                       CASE WHEN p.content_hit THEN 0
                            ELSE ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                                PARTITION BY p.doc_id, p.content_hit
                                ORDER BY p.score DESC, p.chunk_id
                            )
                       END AS _title_rn
                FROM (
            SELECT c.chunk_id,
                   c.doc_id,
                   c.content,
                   c.kind,
                   c.chunk_index,
                   c.first_seen_version,
                   c.last_seen_version,
                   paradedb.score(c.chunk_id) AS score,
                   (c.content_tsv @@ to_tsquery('english', $4)) AS content_hit
            FROM chunks c
            WHERE c.customer_id = current_setting('app.current_customer_id', true)
              AND c.chunk_id @@@ paradedb.boolean(must => ARRAY[
                    paradedb.match('customer_id', $1, conjunction_mode => true),
                    paradedb.term('visibility', 'approved'),
                    
                    paradedb.boolean(should => ARRAY[
                      paradedb.boost(10.0, paradedb.match('title', $2)),
                      paradedb.match('content', $2)
                    ])
                  ])
              AND c.last_seen_version = 2147483647
            ORDER BY paradedb.score(c.chunk_id) DESC
            LIMIT $6
        ) p
            ) q
            WHERE q.content_hit OR q._title_rn <= $7
        ) k
            JOIN documents d
              ON k.doc_id = d.doc_id
             AND d.customer_id = $1
             AND d.version BETWEEN k.first_seen_version AND k.last_seen_version
            WHERE TRUE
              AND d.valid_to IS NULL
              
              
              AND d.visibility = 'approved'
              
              AND (d.metadata->>'source_key' = ANY($5::text[]) OR d.metadata->>'source_key' IS NULL)
              
        ) sub
            ) ranked
            WHERE _ps_rn <= $8
            -- Interleave sources; see the same ORDER BY in vector.py. Ordering
            -- by score would undo the PARTITION one line above and let the
            -- highest-scoring source take every slot under the LIMIT.
            ORDER BY _ps_rn, updated_at DESC, chunk_id
            LIMIT $3
